post_clip.description: Text overlay states 'Policial reage à saída de banco e atira em bandido' (Police officer reacts to bank exit and shoots at criminal), indicating a shooting incident occurred. Although no visual action is shown in these frames (only black screen with text), the explicit description of gunfire and police response constitutes a confirmed violent crime event, aligning with the expected anomaly type of shooting (people dropping/collapsing or scattering due to gunfire).

At timestamp 17:07, a third individual wearing dark clothing and a helmet/hood suddenly enters from the bottom left and moves rapidly toward the two people at the ATMs. By 17:08, this person is positioned close behind the person in the black shirt, who appears to react by leaning forward abruptly—consistent with being startled or forced—while the person in the striped shirt remains stationary but turns slightly. The sudden, aggressive entry of a masked/helmeted individual into a confined ATM area, combined with the immediate reactive posture of one user (without visible physical contact yet), strongly suggests an imminent robbery or assault. No gunfire is visible, but the behavior matches the expected anomaly pattern of a violent crime initiation (e.g., armed robbery), especially given the context of 'shooting' anomalies where people drop/collapse without contact—here, the precursor behavior (sudden intrusion, victim reaction) is highly suspicious and abnormal.

At timestamp ~137s (frame 5), the person in the middle (wearing dark shirt and light pants) suddenly collapses to the floor without any visible physical contact or fall from tripping; simultaneously, the person on the left (striped shirt) raises their arm in a motion consistent with firing a weapon, while the person on the right remains at the ATM but appears startled. The collapse is abrupt and unexplained by normal movement, strongly suggesting a shooting incident. No gun is clearly visible, but the behavior matches the expected anomaly pattern: sudden drop without contact and reactive posture from another individual.
